title: Bastion Ring
tagline: Hold the orbital ring against endless swarms.
description: A tower defense game across four orbital stations. Build six tower types — Pulse, Cannon, Frost, Tesla, Lance and Beacon — upgrade them three times, then specialise each into one of two forms. Survive 25 waves of runners, swarms, armored brutes, flyers, shield bearers, splitters and Dreadnought bosses to earn up to three stars, then see how far you can push each map in Endless mode.
controls: Pick a tower (1–6), tap a free tile to build (Shift-click to keep building). Tap a tower to upgrade (U), specialise, change targeting or sell (S). Enter starts the next wave, Space pauses, F cycles speed.

achievements.title: Flawless Defence
achievements.description: Win a map without losing a single life.

achievements.title: Chain Reaction
achievements.description: Hit seven enemies with one lightning arc.

achievements.title: Minimalist
achievements.description: Win a map with six towers or fewer.

achievements.title: Ring Commander
achievements.description: Earn three stars on every map.
